messages:
maria: Hey team — opened PR #6248 with the migration guide for KMS redaction examples. Preview build looks green but legal flagged an SDK snippet that resembles a real key path. Need legal + sec ACK before merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6248 :eyes:

kyle: thanks — where exactly in the preview? I scanned it quickly and didn't catch anything obvious.

maria: It's under examples/sdks/python.md in the 'KMS integration' section. The snippet uses `projects/redwood-prod/locations/us/keyrings/kr/cryptoKeys/my-key` which looks prod-ish. Legal asked we sanitize.

andre: Can we swap to clearly fake tokens like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/keyR`? Also secops should confirm nothing in the example implies a real, routable KMS name.

legal_jess: hi — saw the preview. Requesting explicit redaction plus a short line reminding readers not to paste real keys. If you replace values with `<REDACED_KEY_ID>` or `<PROJECT_ID>` that's OK. I can sign off within 24h if edits are pushed today.

secops_bob: Secops note: avoid region-specific env values and real-looking project IDs in examples. Anything that looks like `redwood-prod` or `123456789` should be removed. Also flagging that public docs with these patterns could be scraped.

maria: I'll update the snippet now. Quick question — process-wise, do we need both legal and secops explicit +1 in the PR thread, or is a single doc owner merge after legal comment acceptable?

sasha: Process: for redaction-related edits we require one legal ACK and one security ACK before merging. Also add the redaction ticket number to the PR description so compliance can track it.

kyle: I'll make the patch for the snippet and push to `docs/6248-redact-kms`. Will include a preview screenshot in the PR.

docs-ci-bot: CI: preview render passed — build 9423. link: https://deploy.previews/redwood/6248

maria: Pushed change to branch `docs/6248-redact-kms`. @legal_jess can you re-review when you have a sec?

legal_jess: Reviewing now. Quick Q — do we maintain an internal redaction log for doc changes like this?

maria: We usually create a short compliance ticket and add the PR link. I'll open RD-1982 and attach the change.

legal_jess: OK reviewed — changed example to use `<PROJECT_ID>` and `<KEY_NAME>` placeholders and added a one-line caution. LGTM from legal. :white_check_mark:

secops_bob: I checked the rendered preview — no remaining identifiers that look real. Secops ACK. Recommend adding an inline sentence in the guide that examples are illustrative only.

sasha: Excellent. Any outstanding CI blockers? Docs preview green?

docs-ci-bot: All checks passed: spellcheck, lint, preview. netlify preview 9423 active.

kyle: Merged branch to main at 1834127920. Watching for site propagation.

maria: Thanks all — RD-1982 created and linked in the PR. I'll close the loop once the site shows the new content. :tada:

andre: Small process improvement note: we should add a grep/lint for `projects/` or numeric project IDs in code blocks to catch this earlier.

kyle: Good call — I'll add a lint rule to flag project-like strings in fenced code blocks.

maria: Loop closed. Appreciated everyone for the quick turnaround.
